seo.title: A site made of blocks
seo.description: The demo content of a fresh WebX UI site: a page built out of block types made in the panel.

values.title: A site made of blocks
values.subtitle: Every block on this page is a type made in the panel: its fields, its Blade, its styles. Nothing here is written into the layout.

values.heading: What you are looking at
values.body:
This page, the one beside it and the block types behind them came from the command php artisan webx:demo.
Edit any of it in the panel, or run php artisan webx:demo --remove and the site is empty again — still working, still yours.

values.heading: Blocks inside blocks
values.body: A container block prints its children, so a layout is content rather than a template a developer has to deploy.

values.heading: Addresses come from the registry
values.body: Renaming this page rewrites its address and leaves a redirect behind it. Nothing in the layout has to know.
